nom: belif Moisturizing Eye Bomb Eye Cream

segments.dry: Many reviewers with chronically dry or flaky under-eyes report the cream visibly relieves dryness, in some cases after only one or two applications; one reviewer, however, says it left her under-eyes drier and red.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin or eye area as sensitive are split: several say the cream causes no irritation and suits daily use, while others report it triggered watering, redness, swelling, or a reaction they attribute to its fragrance.
segments.combination: The reviewer who identifies as having oily/combination skin says the cream absorbs quickly, isn't heavy or greasy, and doesn't move makeup.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily/combination skin reports the cream doesn't feel greasy, and another notes the non-greasy formula suits oily skin types.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 30s to 70s who mention aging or maturing skin credit the cream with visibly softer lines, firmer texture, and less crepey under-eye skin.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including many with chronically dry or flaky under-eyes, report a visible and often fast increase in hydration; a minority say they noticed no change, and one reviewer reports the cream left her under-eyes drier than before.
concerns.aging: Many reviewers credit the cream with visibly softening fine lines, plumping the under-eye area, and reducing crepey texture, with some describing results building over weeks; a few 3-star reviewers say they saw no noticeable change in their fine lines.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers report the cream caused redness, watering, stinging, or swelling around the eyes, including one describing eye infections (styes/chalazion) in both herself and her mother; most other reviewers report no redness or irritation.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report reduced dark circles or discoloration under the eyes, describing brighter, less dark under-eye skin with regular use.
concerns.oiliness: The few reviewers who comment on oiliness say the cream absorbs without leaving a greasy or shiny film, including one who describes it as suitable for oily skin types.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer notes the cream did not cause acne or any adverse reaction around her sensitive eyes, though acne is not otherwise discussed in these reviews.

Packaging feels wasteful for the amount
A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: Eyes started to become red and dry after shortly using this product.

extraits.titre: Gave both of us eye infections
extraits.texte: This eye cream gave both my mother and I big, fat, stys. Our entire upper eyelids were swollen shut. We only applied this to the undereyes at night, and still woke up with swollen eyelids. My mother's, on one eye, has now turned into a hard, visible chalazion that she will have to get surgically removed or drained. Do not recommend, it's not worth the risk.

One of the most important skin care routines for me is using a good eye cream. This is good and hydrating eye cream that you can use daily. My issue with this is that the product is just have too much of a fragrance for me as I have sensitivity issues and made my eyes water.

I have a hard time generally finding a really good eye cream that I love. I'm getting older, and as that happens I'm starting to get fine lines around my eyes. That being said it is imperative to find a good eye cream to go with a good concealer, that does not settle in the creases around your eyes. And even though I have fine lines I still struggle really bad with acne and oily/combo skin. I love this eye cream because it is not super heavy, oily, greasy, or shiny. It absorbs into my skin almost instantly, so it does not move my makeup around. The texture of it is a cream, but once applied it feels almost like a gel. It is moisturizing without being heavy and I always use this before makeup application.

I got this in a travel pack and recently I've been traveling a lot and using it more. I noticed a significant difference in the moisture in my under eyes when I use this product. It's immediately refreshing, very moisturizing, and calming to any dryer irritation you get after washing your face. I've had it for a while and I turned 30 this year and noticed that my under eyes are a lot dryer and more sensitive. I used it for the first time today after turning 30 (which was a few months ago) and my eyes feel amazing. I honestly did not do not really believe in eye cream, but now that my body is changing and I've used this product after those changes, I am 100% on board. If you're looking for an introductory eye cream to bring moisture to your under eyes and you have sensitive skin, This is the one! Also, I love every single product in my travel/sample kit from this brand. It's really great if you have combination skin and sensitive skin. 10 Out of 10 recommend!

I have had wrinkles under my eyes since I was a teenager. I'm now 37 and I have tried so, so many eye creams under $50. This eye cream is the only one that has not only worked, but the results keep getting better as time goes on, months later. I got a sample back in February, and I was so stunned by the results, I bought a jar in April. I have ZERO undereye wrinkles, and all discoloration has gone away. I swear, this is made of clouds and magic. It feels so soothing when applying. It doesn't overhydrate and make my skin greasy, it's perfect. My husband even noticed a difference. Bottom line, it's absolutely worth the money.

I am 47 years old, very fair skin, and live in Florida. In short, maturing skin that shows every flaw living on the surface of the sun. This has been the only eye cream that has worked so well for me I can't wait to use it every day. Firm, bright, decreased lines, and weightless.
